label: Root links from J. B. Hartle and S. W. Hawking, Wave function of the Universe
summary: pp. 2960–2961, abstract and §I: The compact Euclidean histories in the Hartle–Hawking proposal supply a concrete contrast with ordinary prior-time causation. Application to the case would require an adequate history of the selected spacetime whole and a reason why lacking an earlier physical boundary excludes the specified broader causal relation.
